description: Source code defining classes and objects related to SQL function expressions and context management in Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst analysis module.

classes.name: SQLFunctionExpression
classes.description: Represents a resolved SQL function expression with inputs and return type.

classes.name: SQLScalarFunction
classes.description: Wrapper node for a SQL scalar function expression, extending UnaryExpression.

classes.name: SQLFunctionContext
classes.description: Maintains state during analysis for resolving nested SQL functions, including thread-local management.

methods.name: withSQLFunction
methods.description: Executes a block of code with an incremented nested SQL function depth in the current thread context.
